biography:
Senior Executive with over 24 years of business, strategy and go-to-market experience from a diverse B2B and B2C high growth technology background that includes many building block industries for the digital economy - business transformation enabling datacenters, cloud based service models, location aware mobile technologies, mobile device semiconductor and software platform development, automotive and logistics supply chain.
